heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated $6,000,000 for acquisition of lands and interests in lands for purposes of the Palo Alto Battlefield National Historical Park.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2009—Pub. L. 111–11 substituted “National Historical Park” for “National Historic Site”.
